description: Use when an agent tracks stablecoin liquidity (mints/burns) as a market signal. Input: optional chain (all, ethereum, base), symbol (USDC). Output: JSON per token and chain totalSupply read onchain, change 24 h / 7 d (absolute and %), per-symbol sums, USD net change and direction, biggest movers, block numbers. Ethereum + Base issuances only. Cached 10 min. Example: ?chain=all Price: $0.002 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.
